Sometimes, I would go outside and hide behind the trees in the backyard, making sure my mother wasn't looking. From behind a big mango tree, I would look up, and there she was, beautifully watching over me. I would stay for a couple of minutes and then rush back into the house. 
 
After I turned five, she began to appear less frequently, until she stopped opening the window in the sky to wave at me completely. 
 
I am now 62 years old, and I still look up at the sky while working in my backyard, hoping to see her again. I miss her smile dearly.
